lines.text: At the start of Zedekiah's reign, the LORD told Jeremiah to make a yoke and send word to five kings.
The LORD said He placed all lands under Babylon's king and made the fish of the sea subject to him.
The LORD said He would punish any nation refusing Babylon's yoke, and the prophets saying otherwise prophesied a lie.
Jeremiah told Zedekiah to put his neck under Babylon's yoke and live, not heeding prophets the LORD had not sent.
Nebuchadnezzar left some articles when he exiled Hezekiah, and they will be carried to Babylon.
